assertions.name: covariance_epic_A3_transfer_bound_extension
assertions.source: A3 remainder-domination bound r=g(1)/g'(0) in (0,2) (|R|<|g'(0)|), plus kernel cov(n)<=0 and g'(0)<0, all verified to n=40 at 50dps via exact closed forms. Extends the prior n<=14 window past the n=29 point where the sibling A2 pointwise route failed. Not a proof (needs Kerov-CLT cumulant control). No fit; no c_k.

description: A3 leg-2 (qou-4wl1/qou-x631): EXTENSION of the Phase-7 remainder-domination bound |R|=|g(1)-g'(0)|<|g'(0)| (transfer ratio r=g(1)/g'(0) in (0,2)) from its prior n<=14 window to n<=40, using EXACT closed forms g(1)=(sum f^3 omega3)/(sum f^3) and g'(0)=(1/n!)sum f^2 ln f omega3 (E_2[omega3]=0). Motivated by the sibling A2 pointwise route which was verified only n<=13/15 then FALSIFIED at n=29. RESULT: the bound HOLDS robustly (r stays in (0.5410,0.8743), max|r-1|=0.4590<1); kernel cov(n)<=0 and g'(0)<0 all n. So the A2xA3 sufficient-legs decomposition is NOT a small-n artifact through n=40 (unlike the pointwise route). Still NOT a proof: A3 needs rigorous Plancherel-cumulant control of the mixed cumulants g^(m)(0) (Kerov CLT / Sniady genus). scope-(a); no fit; no c_k; nothing wired; L2 2/7.
